title: Az Erdélyi Fejedelemség (The Principality of Transylvania)
grammar: Concession with bár: Transylvania Between Two Empires

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can outline the autonomy of the Principality of Transylvania.
I can say what the 1568 Diet of Torda declared about religious freedom.
I can link a contrast with bár (Bár Erdély adót fizetett, önálló maradt).
I can use the new words about Transylvanian statehood and culture.
